Vertex AI Pipelines automatically logs every component’s inputs, outputs, parameters, and artifacts into the built‑in ML Metadata store, giving you end‑to‑end lineage for data, models, and evaluation results.

The Vertex AI SDK lets you programmatically log any extra metadata—git commit hashes, container image URIs, custom evaluation reports—directly into the same metadata store from within your training or preprocessing code.
